plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says one of his past guests was a construction worker who told him a blue being appeared in his bedroom and passed advanced physics ideas into his mind. Michels says this brought the man to the attention of two physicists, Eric Davis and Hal Puthoff, who are interested in such cases. If true, it would mean some beings can hand real scientific knowledge to ordinary people.
